question.text: Which of the following is TRUE about enhanced indexing (smart beta) vs pure indexing?

answer.text: Enhanced indexing allows ongoing manager discretion daily
Smart beta has no tracking error
Smart beta is an enhanced index-based, rule-based factor strategy with predetermined rules and periodic rebalancing — sitting between passive index mirroring and discretionary active management
Pure indexing requires daily manager discretion

explanation.text: The Logic: Smart beta / enhanced indexing is a rule-based factor strategy that uses predetermined rules and periodic rebalancing to tilt exposures toward factors such as quality, value, volatility, size and momentum. It sits between passive index mirroring and discretionary active management. The Trap: Smart beta is not zero-tracking-error like pure indexing, and it is not daily-discretionary like active management. Daily discretion would make it active, not smart beta. Note: Pure passive replicates the index; smart beta deviates from cap-weights via rules; active uses ongoing manager judgement.
